register: Criterion flip census (order-free): published stars versus the stars under the stated minimum computed exactly on the full trimmed sample (unique DP optimum per computation, stored in exact_gaps_fullsample_docsonly.json), guardrailed against published prior-year boundaries, display-rounded, aggregated by the stored machinery. No resampling on the criterion side and no input-ordering dependence anywhere in this census; the published computation's order-dependence is the separate replication-gap finding. Conditionality: improvement/CAHPS held at published stars; guardrail priors at published display precision; docsonly score list. Estimate-class dollars: enrollment x $400-600 per enrollee-year, single payment-year month per star year; the three-year total is a sum, never an annual rate; outward rounding on displayed ends; PDP counted, never in the dollar estimate.
conventions: Conventions: (1) one operative score vintage per star year on both sides (2024 recalculated, 2025 current, 2026 current; CMS's 2025 cut points are bit-identical across vintages: re-scored, never re-clustered); (2) guardrail priors keyed by measure name and part (the C28/D01 and C24/D03 cross-part twins do not collide) and MPF Price Accuracy guardrail-exempt in 2024; (3) CMS's >=25% disaster measure-star hold-harmless applied on the criterion side (higher of criterion star and prior-year published star; HOS-class keys on the earlier disaster year, call center never adjusted, CAHPS/improvement held at published throughout; the new-measure with/without overall-level provision is not modeled); (4) all 123 published computations enter; (5) star year 2026's operative bonus baseline is the July-22-2026 updated Summary Ratings; (6) dual-baseline condition: a row enters the dollar estimate only if it flips bonus status against both the published operative overall and the re-rated baseline; single-baseline flips are carried beside with named reasons, never in the dollar estimate.
